problems: The five-pointed star does not look like a star. The cylinder warped into a star has concave n-gon caps, and they render wrong, so the shape reads as an anvil or a T. Rebuild the star from convex pieces: a pentagon core and five triangular points.
The photo square on the ID card renders almost white or pale blue, not grey, so it barely shows against the card. Use a darker grey.

The badge reads as a teardrop or map pin, not a police shield. The warped disc gives a round bulb on top and a narrow point below. It is also small for the flap. Rebuild it as a wider shield with a flat, peaked top, straight sides and a pointed bottom, filling most of the left flap.

The eagle floats apart from the shield. A gap of desk-colored leather shows between them. Its wings are a thin, lumpy chain of beads. The eagle must sit on and overlap the shield's top edge, with broad, continuous spread wings.
The banner's folded tails stick out past the shield's sides and float off its face. The banner must lie on the shield's lower face, inside its outline.
The leather renders mid-grey, not black. Darken both leather materials.
